result.description:
We are partnering with a large and complex organisation to recruit an experienced  Advancement Services Manager  to lead policy, governance and operational improvement initiatives within a high-performing services function. 
     
 
 This is an excellent opportunity for a policy and governance professional with a strong operational background who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, drive change and deliver practical business outcomes. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Lead the development, review and implementation of policy, governance and operating frameworks. 
 Drive strategic projects and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective governance and stakeholder alignment. 
 Prepare business cases, proposals, briefing papers and recommendations for senior leadership and governance forums. 
 Assess and streamline existing processes to improve efficiency, compliance and decision-making. 
 Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to implement change and drive organisational outcomes. 
 Ensure initiatives align with established governance, compliance and technology frameworks. 
 
 Key Requirements 
 
 Demonstrated experience in policy, governance, risk, compliance, business transformation or operational excellence roles. 
 Proven ability to drive policy and governance outcomes within large, complex organisations. 
 Strong operational mindset with experience turning strategy into practical and sustainable solutions. 
 Outstanding stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple business areas. 
 Experience managing competing priorities, leading projects and delivering organisational change. 
 Strong written communication skills, including the preparation of executive papers, business cases and governance documentation. 
 Experience with project management methodologies and tools such as Asana, and exposure to enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, will be highly regarded. 
 
 This role is ideally suited to candidates from higher education, government, corporate or other highly regulated environments who have a track record of driving governance, policy and operational improvements across complex organisations. 
 
    Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples are encouraged to apply. To apply please click apply or call Phillip Yee on +61 2 82893143 for a confidential discussion.

result.description: Peter Vickers Business Group  We're looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Accountant to join Peter Vickers and Associates. Working with a diverse range of clients, you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality accounting, taxation, and business advisory services while helping businesses make informed financial decisions.  From preparing financial statements and tax returns to providing valuable financial insights, you'll work alongside experienced professionals in a supportive and collaborative environment. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career with a respected accounting practice.  The successful applicant will have strong taxation and compliance experience, excellent client relationship skills, and demonstrated knowledge of NSW Land Tax requirements. Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Windsor region or surrounding suburbs.      Benefits  The position offers a competitive salary package of AUD $79,500 - $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, professional development opportunities, career progression and a supportive team environment.   Task & responsibilities  • Manage a portfolio of accounting and taxation clients.  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients.  • Prepare financial statements and tax returns.  • Assist in preparing budgets, cash flow forecasts and accounting policies for clients.  • Prepare financial statements and reports for clients, management and regulatory purposes.  • Prepare and lodge BAS, IAS and other compliance documents.  • Assist clients with budgeting, cash flow forecasts and financial reports.  • Provide advice on Land Tax and taxation matters.  • Liaise with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other government agencies.  • Assist with Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) and payroll compliance.  • Prepare management reports and identify financial issues for clients.  • Maintain and improve accounting systems and advise clients on accounting software and financial processes.  • Review financial information and ensure compliance with accounting standards and legislative requirements.  • Assist in maintaining internal control procedures and risk management processes.  • Build and maintain strong client relationships while providing ongoing accounting and business advisory support.  • Support clients with general accounting and business advisory services.  • Keep up to date with changes in accounting and tax legislation.               Qualification & experience  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline.  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in an accounting role  • Must have either completed or be pursuing CA or related qualification  • Strong knowledge of Australian taxation, BAS and accounting principles.  • Knowledge of NSW Land Tax requirements is essential.  • Strong communication and client relationship management skills.  • Experience using accounting software and Microsoft Office applications.  • Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Windsor region or surrounding suburbs.  About Company    Peter Vickers and Associates Pty Ltd (ABN 60 003 466 813) is a well-established accounting and business advisory firm based in Windsor, NSW. We provide professional accounting, taxation, superannuation and business advisory services to individuals, families and businesses across a broad range of industries. Our team is committed to delivering tailored financial solutions, exceptional client service and practical business advice. We foster a collaborative and supportive workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their skills and build long-term careers.  Kindly submit your application through this advertisement and provide a comprehensive resume and cover letter outlining your skills, qualifications and professional experience.  Applications are open from 29 Jun 2026 to 29 Jul 2026.  Successful applicants who meet the specified criteria will be contacted.  Peter Vickers and Associates Pty Ltd (ABN 60 003 466 813) is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation or cultural background. result.description: Divya Agriculture Management Pty Ltd ATF M H Patel Family Trust  The Accountant will be responsible for managing the company's financial records, preparing financial reports, monitoring budgets, ensuring compliance with taxation and statutory obligations, and providing financial analysis to support informed business decisions. The successful candidate will work closely with management to improve financial performance, maintain strong internal controls, and support the continued growth of the organisation.  This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a sound understanding of Australian accounting standards and taxation legislation.   Benefits   Competitive salary package  Full-time permanent employment  Stable position within a growing agricultural business  Supportive and collaborative workplace culture  Professional development and career progression opportunities  Exposure to diverse financial and business operations  Modern work environment with opportunities to contribute to business improvements  Work-life balance and long-term employment prospects    Task & responsibilities   Prepare, analyse, and maintain financial statements, reports, and management accounts.  Develop and monitor budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections.  Prepare and lodge Business Activity Statements (BAS), tax returns, and other statutory reports.  Ensure compliance with Australian Accounting Standards, taxation legislation, and regulatory requirements.  Analyse financial information and provide recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.  Maintain general ledger accounts and reconcile bank, supplier, and customer accounts.  Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable functions.  Prepare month-end and year-end financial reports and assist with audit requirements.  Develop and maintain internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and reporting systems.  Conduct financial analysis, cost analysis, and variance reporting.  Assist management with business planning, budgeting, and financial decision-making.  Liaise with external accountants, auditors, financial institutions, and government agencies.  Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.  Identify opportunities to improve financial processes and operational efficiencies.    Qualification & experience   Essential    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Accounting, Commerce, Finance, or a closely related discipline.  Demonstrated experience in accounting, financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, and financial analysis.  Strong knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards, taxation legislation, GST, BAS, payroll, and financial reporting requirements.  Experience using accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, or similar financial management systems.  Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial reporting skills.  Excellent analytical, organisational, and problem-solving abilities.  Strong written and verbal communication skills.  High level of accuracy, integrity, and attention to detail.    Desirable    Experience within the agriculture, labour hire, logistics, or service industries.  Knowledge of payroll processing and employment compliance requirements.  Experience with budgeting, financial modelling, and business performance reporting.  Understanding of trust accounting and family business financial structures.   About Company     The Trustee for M H PATEL FAMILY TRUST T/A DIVYA AGRICULTURE MANAGEMENT PTY LTD  is a Queensland-based agricultural services and workforce management company located in Gatton, in the heart of the Lockyer Valley. The business provides comprehensive agricultural management solutions, including crop production support, farm labour services, harvesting, planting, irrigation, packing, and operational management for agricultural enterprises across Queensland. The company is committed to delivering reliable, compliant, and high-quality services while maintaining strong financial governance and operational excellence.
